title: Implement a fixed-capacity circular buffer in Rust
description: Implement CircularBuffer<T> with fixed capacity. push overwrites oldest element when full. pop removes from the front. Implement is_empty, is_full, len.

task_spec.prompt:
Implement CircularBuffer<T> in src/lib.rs using a Vec<Option<T>> of fixed capacity with head and tail indices:
- `new(capacity)`: allocate Vec of capacity Nones, head=0, tail=0, len=0
- `push(item)`: store at buf[tail % capacity], advance tail; if full (len==capacity) advance head too (overwrite oldest); else increment len
- `pop()`: if empty return None; take buf[head % capacity], advance head, decrement len, return Some(item)
- `is_empty()`: len == 0
- `is_full()`: len == capacity
- `len()`: return len
All 3 tests must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test --quiet` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `cargo test --quiet` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
